steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to ERPNext at http://127.0.0.1:8100/ as Administrator using password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}, and verify that the signed-in app is accessible.

02-find: Find the existing Sales Orders whose customer name starts with 'Seed:' without modifying any order. Report the customer names exactly as shown on the Sales Order records, and verify that this is the complete matching set.
03-create: Create a customer named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (leave customer group and territory at defaults). Save it and verify the created customer record/name.

04-create: Create a Sales Order for the existing customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with delivery date 2026-12-31 and exactly two item lines: choose 'Bench Widget' from item suggestions at its default rate, quantity 3; choose 'Bench Gadget' from suggestions at its default rate, quantity 2. Save as a draft and verify customer, delivery date, both exact linked items, quantities, and their rates; report the rates observed.
05-verify: Submit Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}}, confirming the submission if ERPNext prompts. Verify the order is submitted (not draft) and report its displayed status.
06-add: Add a timeline comment to Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} whose text includes exactly the runid '{{runid}}'. Verify the comment appears on that order's timeline and report its full text.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
